resources.name: DFT package with PAW (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP)

access.notes: Open-source Quantum ESPRESSO is acceptable. The original paper used VASP (commercial), but any PAW-capable DFT code can be used.

resources.notes: Must support LDA exchange-correlation and PAW method.
